verdicts.reason: A: a clean left-to-right banner (product, headline, CTA) with sensible hierarchy, but the jar is tiny and its 'SOLSTICE' label can't be read, the leftover circle decoration is a cramped smudge in the corner, and the CTA sits close to the right edge. B: the CTA wraps onto two lines and is jammed against the right edge, where 'SOLSTICE' looks cut off; it is almost as large as the headline, so the two compete; the jar is tiny with an unreadable label; and the left third is dead space, which leaves the layout lopsided.
